notes.title: Historical Mode
notes.content:
Added a whole new way to play 'Historical mode'. 

In Historical mode all the unit values and chances to hit enemy units are as historically accurate as possible. 

As a result it may be much harder to destroy enemies resulting in missions being harder to complete.

tags.feature: Added a whole new way to play 'Historical mode'.
